name: Pharmacy operations console
decisions: Use a dense, calm medical operations interface with a blue primary scale, light neutral sidebar, and white work surfaces.
Prioritize POS search and cart speed; keep operational tables compact and readable.
Use color only for inventory, expiry, payment and transaction status—not decoration.
Every data view includes loading, error and empty states and remains usable on narrow screens.
Open record edits in a full-height right workspace panel; its backdrop covers only the main workspace on desktop and the full viewport on mobile.
Use one shared period dropdown with an inline exact-date input across Sales and Reports, paired with summary metrics above transaction tables.
Use a focused payment confirmation dialog with a prominent amount due, explicit payment-method verification, cash tender shortcuts, and live due/change feedback.

Use flat, compact POS product cards with border and background state changes instead of shadows or lift animations; expose price, availability, SKU, prescription status, and in-sale quantity at a glance.

Arabic is the only interface language and the application shell is RTL; preserve English catalog names and render identifiers, codes, dates, currency values, and numbers with Latin digits and isolated LTR direction.
